_comment: The current targeting snapshot, loaded by `manage.py targeting_import --from-manifest`. Rebuilding this dataset from source costs 30-45 minutes of API calls and can exhaust WorldPop's daily quota for everyone else, so a new environment should restore from here rather than re-fetch. Pin a new drive_file_id whenever the dataset changes materially: export, upload to the folder below (shared with connect-labs-sa), and update the id, created_at and counts in one commit so the file and the record stay together.
notes: Restore with: make manage CMD="targeting_import --from-manifest" (needs LABS_SYNTHETIC_GDRIVE_SA_KEY; it is already in the ECS task definition, and locally can be read from Secrets Manager as labs-jj-synthetic-gdrive-sa-key with the labs AWS profile). ADM1 population is now complete: pop_u1 covers 754 of 778 admin-1 boundaries, and the other 24 are ones WorldPop itself returns no data for, so 754 is the ceiling at this level rather than a pause. Births come from the infant cohort for all 754, against 315 two days ago. ADM2 population is still empty (0 of 1,518), so a selection resolving at district level under-counts births — population is a count and cannot be inherited from the province above. Fetching it needs `load_indicators --stage population --source worldpop --levels 2`, which is several days of daily quota.
